newsitem.title: USA: Ecopetrol sells two Cusiana cargoes to US refiner.
newsitem.headline: Ecopetrol sells two Cusiana cargoes to US refiner.

text.p: Colombian state oil company Ecopetrol sold two early August cargoes of Cusiana crude oil to a U.S. refiner at 95 cts a barrel under West Texas Intermediate/Cushing, trade sources said on Thursday.
The 550,000 barrel cargoes, which load August 4-8 and August 10-14, were the first August shipments to be sold and are likely to be co-loaded into the U.S. Gulf Coast.
Equity producer British Petroleum also sold a separate Cusiana cargo loading August 1-5 after Ecopetrol's transactions at an undisclosed discount to September WTI, traders said.
